patch_description: Structural redesign around a unified pipeline: (1) all geometry handled in barycentric coordinates with vectorized projection (removing per-point Python loops); (2) a single annealed optimizer that sharpens the soft-min temperature k from 30 to 120 during Phase 1, per the recommendation, smoothing the transition into the hard-min Phase 2 polish; (3) restart loop budgeted by wall-clock that perturbs the vertices of the current minimal triangle (basin hopping) rather than only doing static multi-start, with greedy step-halving polish as the final deterministic stage. frac stays at 0.05 of triplets for the soft-min pool. Fixed seed, full fallback lattice, results cached at module import.
